digest.en: Asia-Pacific leads the board this hour with Myanmar’s New Administration: Military Consolidation, Not Transition. Middle East & Africa carries the next thread. 25 fresh dispatches in this edition.
digest.hi: इस घंटे बोर्ड पर मध्य पूर्व और अफ्रीका की अगुवाई है, ईरान-अमेरिका ने दोहा में की वार्ता, पर नहीं आए एक-दूसरे के सामने, ट्रंप-नेतन्याहू की सुलह मुख्य खबर है। साथ ही एशिया-प्रशांत से भी घटनाक्रम सामने आया है। कुल 25 ताज़ा खबरें इस संस्करण में हैं।

articles.title: Myanmar’s New Administration: Military Consolidation, Not Transition
articles.summary: Min Aung Hlaing transitioned from commander-in-chief to president in Five years after mounting a coup that ousted an elected civilian government, Min Aung Hlaing has overseen tightly staged elections transitioning him from commander-in-chief to president. Foreign governments should ensure interaction with Naypyitaw is calibrated, so as not to confer unwarranted legitimacy on the administration. Myanmar’s New Administration: Military Consolidation, Not Transition.

articles.title: Issues of War and Peace Gain Top Billing in Armenia’s Election
articles.summary: Armenians will vote in a general election on 7 June. Armenians will head to the polls on 7 June for the country’s first general election since 2021. articles.title: Mother fails in court bid to get ex-husband to foot half their daughter's Australia university bill
articles.summary: A mother's court bid to compel her ex-husband to pay half their daughter's Australian university fees failed. articles.title: The logical case for admitting Bangladesh into ASEAN
articles.summary: Bangladesh's foreign policy under ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina focused heavily on India For decades, Bangladesh’s foreign policy operated on a predictable, singular axis. Under the sixteen-year tenure of ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, Dhaka’s strategic and economic relations were deeply tethered to New Delhi. A flurry of bilateral agreements spanning digital connectivity, transit rights, and maritime security signaled a tight, almost exclusive alignment with Indian interests.

articles.title: A baseball stadium becomes a refuge in Venezuela
articles.summary: The baseball stadium at Playa Grande, Venezuela, now serves as an emergency shelter. Where children once trained as baseball players, families now sleep under tarpaulins.
